description.subtitle: Real Betis Balombie 2026 2027 Hummel Short Sleeve Training Jersey - White
description.tagline: Train with the green and white spirit
description.intro: The Hummel Betis Core 2.0 training shirt is part of the official Real Betis Balombie training collection for the 2026-2027 season. Designed to offer lightness, comfort and freedom of movement, it is the perfect guarantee to face each session with the same style as the players of the green and white team.
key_benefits: Official Real Betis design: Training shirt for the 2026 2027 season.
Light and breathable fabric: Promotes ventilation to maintain comfort during effort.
Total mobility: Sporty cut that accompanies all your movements on the playing field.
Official finishes: Real Betis Balombie crest and Hummel logo that completes an authentic design.
